name: Oracle SCM
tagline: Oracle Supply Chain Management (SCM) Cloud is an enterprise suite covering procurement, inventory, logistics, manufacturing, and order management. Its AI-driven demand sensing adjusts forecasts weekly using real-time signals — including point-of-sale data, weather, and social trends — to reduce excess inventory and prevent stock-outs. Global enterprises standardise on Oracle SCM to get a single, integrated view of their supply chain.
